name: QwQ_Benchmark_Distill
description: A distilled dataset derived from the QwQ benchmark aimed at producing paired question–answer (and sometimes rationale) data for model distillation. It is used to teach or fine-tune models to reproduce reasoning-oriented answers or distilled responses from stronger models. The benchmark measures a model's ability to generate correct answers and maintain reasoning quality after distillation.
reputation: Niche dataset used by researchers focused on distillation and reasoning improvements; limited broad adoption outside that community.
